introduction:
The Ration Card (Rice Card) in Andhra Pradesh is issued by the Department of Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies, Government of Andhra Pradesh. It enables eligible families to obtain subsidized food grains and essential commodities through the Public Distribution System (PDS).

This card also serves as a crucial document for identity and residential proof, and acts as a gateway for several state welfare schemes. You can apply for a new card or split an existing household card.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Purpose: To access subsidized food grains and essential commodities through the Public Distribution System (PDS).
  • Eligibility: Must be a permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh and not already possess a valid ration card. For splitting, you must satisfy the six-step eligibility validation.
  • Six-Step Validation: All applications must pass the strict "Six-Step Validation" check (verifying electricity usage under 300 units, no four-wheeler ownership, urban property ownership under 1000 sq ft, no government employment/pension, no income tax payer status, and meeting income limits).
  • Service Fee (Cost): The official service charge for applying for a new Ration/Rice Card is ₹100. Splitting an existing Rice Card online carries a gateway fee of ₹48.
  • Processing Time: Officially standard up to 180 days, but most applications are successfully processed within approximately 21 days.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Mandatory Documents (New / Split)
  • Aadhaar Card: Scanned copies/numbers of Aadhaar cards for all family members.
  • Mobile Number: Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar for OTP-based verification and e-KYC.
  • Current Rice Card Number: Required if applying to split from an existing card.
  • Check-list Form: A mandatory government-provided check-list form that must accompany a new application.
Residence & Financial Proof
  • Proof of Address: Valid documents confirming your residence in Andhra Pradesh (e.g., recent electricity bill, voter ID, or tax receipt).
  • Income & Occupation Details: Required to verify the family's eligibility against household income limits.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via AP Seva Portal

Option A: Splitting an Existing Rice Card (Ration Card)
  1. Verify Scheme Eligibility: First, visit the official Scheme Eligibility Check portal at gsws-nbm.ap.gov.in. Enter your Aadhaar number, select "Rice Card" from the scheme type drop-down, select the current year, and authenticate using the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
  2. Check Six-Step Validation: Once logged in, review your family details and make a note of your "Cluster" number located in the Citizen Details section. Scroll down to the validation section and ensure all six steps show a "Satisfied" status.
  3. Log in to AP Seva: Go to apseva.ap.gov.in, click on "Login" at the top right, select "Citizen Login," and log in. Register first if you do not have an account.
  4. Select Split Service: On your dashboard, navigate to "Services," select "Consumer Affairs, Food and Civil Supplies," and click on "Splitting of Rice Card."
  5. Data Entry & Mobile Verification: Enter your Aadhaar number and click "Pre-fill" to load your data. Manually fill in any missing information (father's name, religion, marital status, and education). Enter your mobile number, click "Verify" to confirm via OTP, and select whether the number is linked to WhatsApp.
  6. Address & Household Income: Review your permanent and present addresses. Enter your family's annual income (must be ₹40,000 or above) and select your occupation. Enter the Cluster number you noted down earlier in the "Habitation" field.
  7. Select Split Members & HOF: Under "Rice Card Family Details," select "Normal Split." From the list of family members, select the specific members who are separating to form the new card. Assign their new relationships, choosing "Self/HOF" for the person who will be the Head of the Family on the new card.
  8. Submit & Pay Fee: Check the agreement boxes at the bottom and click "Submit Split Family." You will be redirected to pay a fee of ₹48 via credit/debit card, net banking, UPI, or QR code. Save the generated Payment Receipt containing your Application Number (T-number).
Option B: Applying for a New Ration Card
  1. Portal Access: Go to the official AP Seva Portal.
  2. Login: Log in to the citizen portal using your registered credentials or by validating through your Aadhaar-linked mobile number via OTP.
  3. Select Service: Search and select the "New Ration Card Application" option under the Civil Supplies department.
  4. Fill Details: Input all family member details, occupation, and monthly/annual household income details.
  5. Upload Documents: Upload the required supporting documentation, including Aadhaar cards, address proof, income certificate, and the mandatory check-list form.
  6. Complete e-KYC: Complete the online e-KYC verification using the Aadhaar OTP authentication step.
  7. Submit and Payment: Review details, click "Submit", and pay the service charge of ₹100 via UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking. Save the generated Transaction/Application Number.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline at Grama/Ward Sachivalayam

If you prefer an offline method, you can complete the process at a local secretariat office:

  1. Visit local Secretariat: Visit your local Grama Sachivalayam (village secretariat) or Ward Sachivalayam (urban secretariat) office or MeeSeva Center.
  2. Submit Documents: Submit the physical application form alongside the mandatory check-list form and copies of all family member Aadhaar cards. For splitting, provide the current Rice Card number.
  3. Data Verification: Ensure all details entered match your Aadhaar records precisely to avoid immediate rejection during data entry.
  4. e-KYC & Routing: The counter operator will perform the biometric/OTP-based e-KYC and forward the application to the VRO (Village Revenue Officer), MRO, or RI for local verification.
  5. Payment & Receipt: Pay the service charge (₹100 for a new card, or ₹48/₹100 depending on the split service type) and collect your acknowledgment receipt containing your unique Application/Transaction Number (T-number).
afterApplying:
After Applying — Validation & Approval Flow

Track Your Application

Use your Application Number (T-number) on the AP Seva portal or the AEPDS website to check your application status.

Mandatory eKYC

For splitting, visit your nearest Sachivalayam (Secretariat) with your T-number to complete your eKYC using biometrics or OTP. Your application will not move forward until this step is completed.

Field Verification

Once your e-KYC is completed, your application is forwarded to the VRO (Village Revenue Officer) and subsequently to the MRO/RI for physical verification and final approval.

New Rice Card Number Retrieval

Once approved, visit epdsap.ap.gov.in. Click on "Dashboard," look under the "Ration Card" section, and click on "EPDS Application Search." Enter your T-number and click "Search" to view your newly generated Rice Card number.

Important: Six-Step Validation

Even if an application is submitted, it will not progress or get approved if the family records fail the Six-Step Validation checks (for electricity, four-wheelers, urban property, tax payer status, and government employment).
